I replied to Ilse in our DM to confirm I have the new date: the Quarrendon Freight Lines paperwork cutoff is now 7 July. I said I'd keep it between us and take no action. I also asked them to confirm the year, since 7 July 2026 has already passed and I'm assuming they mean 7 July 2027.

I checked GBrain first. It has nothing on this cutoff and nothing that contradicts it, but the search ran keyword-only, so it may have missed differently worded notes. I didn't save the date to GBrain because other people can read it, and Ilse asked for this to stay private. It isn't anywhere else either. The DM thread is the only record, so I'll only see it later if I read that DM again.
